nodes.summary: Prospective design: independently lay out a broad-headed, offset working-toe tool, a two-member passage shuttle, and a three-member target crossbar. The tool approaches a void-constrained target from above. After contact, its toe occupies the shuttle destination; the tool must retreat upward before the shuttle can move right to open the gem passage. Keep a west-side recovery route and an explicit gem-and-return endpoint.

notes.label: Create a genuinely new constrained-transport room with a connected tool-use, recovery, and shared-passage release sequence, collecting a gem and returning to the initial entry.
notes.goal: Create a genuinely new constrained-transport room with a connected tool-use, recovery, and shared-passage release sequence, collecting a gem and returning to the initial entry.
notes.change: Prospective design: independently lay out a broad-headed, offset working-toe tool, a two-member passage shuttle, and a three-member target crossbar. The tool approaches a void-constrained target from above. After contact, its toe occupies the shuttle destination; the tool must retreat upward before the shuttle can move right to open the gem passage. Keep a west-side recovery route and an explicit gem-and-return endpoint.
notes.reason: This changes the original workspace topology and rigid shapes. It uses a forced post-contact recovery followed by lateral shuttle release, rather than reproducing the official room's large helper exchanges. Claims remain hypotheses until ordinary-engine and restriction checks finish. Raw reference states were delivered through recorded read but the console display was truncated; targeted state projections will be recorded separately. An attempted read of the guessed filename scripts/complex-core.cjs failed; the actual helper is complex-runtime.cjs. Initial observer viewer launch failed with EADDRINUSE; subsequent recording uses the existing run with viewer startup disabled.
expectedChecks: Each of the three roles necessary
Tool down/up ordered recovery before usable shuttle-right opportunity
No walking-only completion after first contact
A saved replay bound to the exact final cells and contract
Actual browser play, Undo/Reset and editor save/export

notes.label: Remove the actual axial-input bypass exposed by the first complete structural verification.
notes.goal: Remove the actual axial-input bypass exposed by the first complete structural verification.
notes.change: Replace floor beneath the initial eastern tool-head member at (9,8) with void, preserving the connected tool footprint and its other supporting members. Record both voids and the inaccessible axial stance explicitly.
notes.reason: The ordinary witness and all three role freezes passed, but forbidding lateral contact still yielded a complete solution: the player could stand in the toe column and perform an axial push of the same tool. That bypass also invalidated the ordered contact-recovery and post-contact-only claims. The revised terrain removes that specific player stance while retaining supported offset delivery from the western head. This is an observed counterexample-driven revision, not a claim that the original geometry already required lateral contact.
expectedChecks: Replay the same prospective route with ordinary moves
Check the ordered contact then upward recovery before shuttle opportunity
Recheck all dependencies and post-contact work from the revised initial state

notes.label: Hand off the final structurally verified candidate for independent browser Play and editor persistence QA.
notes.goal: Hand off the final structurally verified candidate for independent browser Play and editor persistence QA.
notes.change: Candidate v002 passes all 33 complex structural checks. Retain the earlier axial bypass, the failed first verification, and the geometry revision. The verified route is DDLLDDRRUDRRDDRLUULLLLUUUURR: 28 inputs, five object-moving inputs, and three dependent functional stages.
notes.reason: Offset contact moves the target crossbar at input 2; upward tool recovery at input 9 clears the shared shuttle row; shuttle movement at inputs 11-12 opens the gem pocket. Collection occurs at input 15 and the route returns to (6,7,0). Search exhaustion supports only the declared restrictions; this compact puzzle has no human-difficulty or independent-author claim. Browser play/save/export remains pending the batch runner.
expectedChecks: Batch browser Play compares every saved frame
Final run audit after browser evidence is attached
